# App shell > The application container: persistent navigation and header around changing page content, with one shared scroll policy. Status: beta. This file matches the installed `app-shell` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/app-shell.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/app-shell.md`. ## Registry dependencies - `core` - `page-layout` - `sidebar` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/app-shell-header-knobs`: `appShellHeaderKnobs`, types `AppShellHeaderKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/app-shell`: `AppShell`, `AppShellContent`, `AppShellHeader`, types `AppShellProps`, `AppShellHeaderProps` ## Composition ### Persistent application frame AppShell includes SidebarProvider. Set scroll once: page uses the document, inset lets PageLayout scroll, and none lets workspace panes own scrolling. Keep the shell mounted while route content loads. ```tsx route content ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { InboxIcon, SettingsIcon } from "lucide-react"; import { useState } from "react"; import { AppShell, AppShellContent, AppShellHeader } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/app-shell"; import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/avatar"; import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button"; import { PageBody, PageHeader, PageLayout, PageTitle } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/page-layout"; import { Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarGroup, SidebarHeader, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarRail, SidebarTrigger, } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/sidebar"; import { Skeleton } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/skeleton"; import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography"; export function PrimitiveAppShellExample() { const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false); return ( }> A Acme Inbox Settings AppShellHeader Page content {loading ? (
Loading inbox…
) : ( AppShellContent holds the current page. Toggle loading to see the sidebar and header stay in place. )} ); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `app-shell` - `root` ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### app-shell-header - `--cui-app-shell-header-height`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 14)` - `--cui-app-shell-header-padding-inline`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)` - `--cui-app-shell-header-background`: `var(--background)` - `--cui-app-shell-header-border-color`: `var(--border)` - `--cui-app-shell-header-border-width`: `1px` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/app-shell - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/app-shell-header.json
